text:
Happy am I, if I temper my dreams

as they rush toward this precipice.

Yesterday it was a temple; today, its trace.

Where can I flee, if the temple suffers?


Just, though adverse, I behold you, Jove,

if warning comes before the punishment,

and less vengeful than kind

if I learn from you what I await.


Yet, Father of Heaven, whatever lies

lofty within your vast, ordained power

accuses your harshness, as its creator.


Does what is born exalted somehow sin?

Is greatness itself a crime? If so,

Jove, strike down Nature!

translation.title: Happy am I, if I temper my dreams
